A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated that the risk of stent thromboses is very low with second- and third- generation drug-eluting stent.
the duration of dual anti-platelet therapy should be at least 12 months after drug-eluting-stent implantation, and should probably be extended to 24 months in high-risk patients.

the risk of stent thromboses is highest in the first year after implantation, and that the risk of bleeding is highest in the second year.
